description: This Java class 'TestPassAuthenticator' extends 'TestFailAuthenticator' and provides a mock implementation for authentication, always returning true for the 'authenticate' method and false for 'isEnabled'. It is used for testing purposes within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: TestPassAuthenticator
classes.description: A test authenticator class that always approves user authentication. Extends TestFailAuthenticator.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Returns true indicating successful authentication; logs method call details.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns false indicating the authenticator is disabled.

calls: Debug.logInfo(this.getClass().getName() + " Authenticator authenticate() -- returning false", MODULE)
